ok pasting my cover note for harrowgate, need it tighter. tailored resume v19 for this one already

"Hi Harrowgate team, I'm a junior in logistics management at Bayshore State and I am wanting a summer 2026 supply chain analyst internship in the Bay Area. My sister's former colleague is referring me into Harrowgate, and I have attached my resume. In my warehouse sim project I cut tote travel time by 18 percent, which I think shows I can think about flow. I would love to chat about how I could help your team. Thank you for your time."

Happy to tighten it. Here's a leaner version:

"Hi Harrowgate team,

I'm a junior in logistics management at Bayshore State, applying for a summer 2026 supply chain analyst internship in the Bay Area. [Referrer's name], a former colleague of my sister's, suggested I apply, and my resume is attached.

In my warehouse simulation project, I cut tote travel time by 18%, which reflects how I approach flow problems: measure first, then fix the bottleneck. I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I can contribute to your team.

Thank you for your time,
[Your name]"

Changes: cut "I am wanting" to a cleaner phrasing, led with the role, and put the referral in one sentence. Since the referral is your strongest hook, drop the referrer's actual name in where I put the placeholder. Want a shorter two-sentence version too?

ngl the placeholder is the name part, its already in the form field too. this will be app 82 in the spreadsheet, color coded row and everything. another message in a bottle but with a lifeguard this time

A lifeguard is a solid upgrade. Since the referrer's name is in the form field, you can keep the note's mention light and still reinforce it:

"Hi Harrowgate team,

I'm a junior in logistics management at Bayshore State, applying for a summer 2026 supply chain analyst internship in the Bay Area. I was referred by [referrer's name], a former colleague of my sister's, and my resume is attached.

In my warehouse simulation project, I cut tote travel time by 18%. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute.

Thank you,
[Your name]"

That's about 70 words, easy to skim. Fill in the name and it's ready to submit.
